system.description:
A voice of the underclass in Mournas and every city like it: satirists, protest singers, broadsheet writers. Art as disruption.

  • Hostile Crowd: Sway Crowd works even on an actively hostile crowd if you can perform for at least 1 round uninterrupted. When a creature fails its save against your Discord, one ally who can hear you can move up to half their speed towards it without provoking.
    • 9th level: the ally can move its full speed.
  • Underground Voice: Advantage on Legend Lore checks on a city's criminal history, underground movements and rebellions.
